name: manual_89de9a
claim: In repositories with background commit or sync automation, re-check HEAD, the cached diff, and upstream state immediately before committing or pushing, then verify the intended commit remains in remote history.

decisions.notes: The Obsidian backup automation committed and pushed while this session was preparing an isolated commit, so previously observed index and branch state became stale.

rationale: The Obsidian backup automation committed and pushed while this session was preparing an isolated commit, so previously observed index and branch state became stale.
